info.name: CAB System - phieucham PC6-PC30
info.description: Run sequentially on local seeded stack. PC19 creates an ONLINE payment after trip completion and confirms it through the sandbox callback. PC24: inspect DB using document/database-and-postman.md. Wait 60 seconds between runs.

exec: pm.test("PC8 Internal routes blocked status", () => pm.response.to.have.status(404));
pm.test("PC10 Login new customer status", () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));
pm.test("PC14 Booking history paging status", () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));
pm.test("5 seeded bookings and page 2", () => { pm.expect(data.total).to.be.at.least(5); pm.expect(data.items).to.have.length(2); pm.expect(data.page).to.eql(2); });
pm.test("PC17 Reject skipped transition status", () => pm.response.to.have.status(409));
pm.test("PC19 Choose online payment status", () => pm.response.to.have.status(201));
pm.test("PC19 Perform sandbox payment status", () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));
pm.test("PC19 Check payment result status", () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));
pm.test("PC18 New booking for cancellation status", () => pm.response.to.have.status(201));
pm.test("PC18 Find cancellation offer status", () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));
pm.test("PC18 Assign cancellation trip status", () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));
pm.test("PC18 Driver cancels unpaid trip status", () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));
pm.test("PC21 Request random OTP status", () => pm.response.to.have.status(202));
pm.test("PC21 Verify random OTP status", () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));
pm.test("PC22 Approved driver login status", () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));
